payload.title: Basic timeseries manipulation
payload.description: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates basic timeseries manipulation using the Pyleoclim library. It focuses on preprocessing a timeseries by standardizing, gaussianizing, and slicing data. The notebook uses sea-surface temperature data from the NINO3 region and provides methods to view summary statistics, standardize, and gaussianize the data. The outputs include visualizations comparing the original, standardized, and gaussianized timeseries.
